content.rendered:
And so we’ve reached the end of the Cover Me series.

It’s incomplete, as it was always destined to be. Trying to catalog and chronicle every song Bruce Springsteen has ever covered is the very definition of chasing a moving target.

Even so, I’m sure some of you will notice the absence of a few classics. I’m at peace with it, though. John Fogerty has so many entries in this series that I can forgive myself for never getting around to “Proud Mary.” (I did write an entry for “Travelin’ Band” specifically for this book, though. That one I couldn’t leave out.)

There is, however, one particular cover that will probably render you aghast if and when you realize its omission. That’s intentional, because I always intended it to be the last essay I would ever write for the blog. It’ll see publication as the last entry in Volume 50 of the Bookshelf Collection sometime in late 2027 or early 2028.

Thanks for reading Cover Me over the years. This was the series I always enjoyed writing the most.  I hope you enjoy reading the final collection.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Spare Parts: Cheap Motel
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Co-written but never performed by Bruce, Joe Grushecky's "Cheap Motel" sure *sounds* like a Bruce song. Take a listen inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Spare Parts: Dan Patrick Fulton: (I’m/Sex) On Fire
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Dan Patrick Fulton pulls off a brilliant mash-up and perfect pairing of "I'm on Fire" with "Sex on Fire" by Kings of Leon.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, CO.RO. and Taleesa: Because the Night
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: This Springsteen/Depeche Mode mash-up took the European charts by storm in 1992-93.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Kathleen Edwards: Human Touch
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Canadian singer-songwriters Kathleen Edwards and Afie Jurvanen quietly released one of the best covers of "Human Touch."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, HouseHolder Reloaded: The Wayfarer
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Our final Cover Me entry before our month-long hiatus is Boss-approved! Check out this lovely arrangement of a Western Stars deep cut.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, The Mandrillos: Cross My Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: "Cross My Heart" always had more potential than its album arrangement allowed for, and this three-man combo proves it.
